summary: Safety gate on rendering people, and specifically on rendering children. ALLOW_ALL permits adults and children, ALLOW_ADULT permits adults but not children, and ALLOW_NONE blocks images of people entirely.
combines: Lixpi never sends it, so whatever the API applies by default is what every Gemini image gets. Setting it is the only way to guarantee a stricter floor than the account default.
The distinction that actually matters is children: ALLOW_ADULT is the setting that blocks minors while still allowing people.
It lives inside imageConfig, which google-provider.ts:281 currently builds from the aspect ratio alone, so wiring it up means changing that line rather than adding a parameter next to it.
